text: At its meeting on February 26, 2025, the Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal considered Item ND6.1 and made a recommendation to City Council. Summary from the report (February 10, 2025) from the City Clerk The Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.
City Council on March 26 and 27, 2025, deferred Item CC28.7 to the April 23, 24 and 25, 2025, meeting of City Council.
